Pakistani Minister Defends Cricket Team, Cites India's Loss

Pakistan's interim Minister for Information, Mohsin Naqvi, defended the Pakistani cricket team's performance amidst criticism. When questioned about the team's struggles, Naqvi drew parallels to other teams' performances, including India's recent loss to Ireland. He also mentioned Namibia's victory over South Africa as an example of unexpected outcomes in cricket. The coverage also includes a separate report about Pakistan calling Kashmiri separatist Yasin Malik 'innocent' after he was imprisoned in India.
